answer: A trellis of mutual attestations can choke Sybil attacks at the door. A new vertex joins only after three established, mutually independent agents each stake reputation and a small bond to vouch for it, and each voucher may endorse only a few newcomers per epoch. An attacker wanting a hundred fake identities must either buy a hundred genuine endorsements, each costing a voucher's standing and bond, or build a fake cluster whose attestations all trace back to the same few vertices, a pattern the graph exposes at once. Even a whisper of collusion costs the vouchers their bonds.
